name: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd.
summary: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cement and related products primarily in Japan. It operates through six segments: Cement, Mineral Products, Building Materials, Optoelectronics, New Materials, and Others. The company offers cement, cement-based solidification materials, electric power supply, recycling, and ready-mix concrete; limestone for steelmaking, road construction, aggregate, calcium carbonate, dolomite, antibacterial agents, cosmetic materials, various functional paints, and silica powder; optical communication components and measuring equipment; and ceramic products and nanoparticle materials.
